source_evidence.text: We will keep the forty-percent walk-in share under the revised occupancy, add same-day return times at the desk and by phone, use staggered reservation releases, and set a household-sized cap with assisted booking for larger groups.
Promotion will go through tourism and neighborhood channels at the same time.
We will count immediate entry, offered return times, abandoned visits, confirmations, and released capacity separately.
The ten-week contract, privacy limits, weekly publication, and early walk-in adjustment remain unchanged.
